skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of database systems and land database systems. Analyze, design, and build land database systems to support land management tasks.
Proficient use of GIS software (e.g., Mapinfo) to build, manage, and utilize land databases.
Design, analyze, and build land databases suitable for practical land management tasks.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve problems related to land database systems.
Demonstrate the ability to independently learn and understand materials to complete assignments and tasks.
Work effectively in groups to complete tasks and projects related to land database systems.
Identify and solve problems related to land database systems.
